limitations: River names describe geographic vicinity; channel identity has not been independently verified.
A monitored point does not represent an entire district or river basin.
ERA5 and GloFAS are modelled products, not local gauge measurements.
Percentile severity is an analytical heuristic, not an official warning or flood probability.
Recent IFS weather and forecast-backed GloFAS data differ from the older reanalysis products; source changes must be considered when interpreting trends.
No independently labelled flood-event ground truth was used; replay episodes are algorithmically identified.
baseline_method: Full-archive, same-calendar-month, retrospective midrank; past classifications may change after updates.
refresh_storage: Daily published archive; original hourly collection is separate historical evidence.
